[RFCS.17.3] An atom appearing in a container its container-legality does not admit is
**malformed**; a reader that knows the atom **must** reject such a container. (A reader
with no table entry cannot make this diagnosis — the band disposition governs it
instead, which is safe because a misplaced *input* is what the reject bands catch blind,
per [RFCS.16.3].)
